dct_description_sm: The purpose of the collection of this data is to publish findings of community-led assessments of food security conditions in Inuit communities and the effectiveness of food interventions to address food access challenges.  This work will be published in academic journals and community reports, but primarily is being gathered to support informed decision-making at the community and regional levels on these issues in Nunatsiavut and Nunavut.

dct_title_s: Community-led Food Assessments in Nunatsiavut and Nunavut
